later_image_snapshot.interpretation: This is a later image's metadata snapshot, not the earlier 249-distribution installation comparison. No after-campaign package-manifest comparison has yet been collected.

local_transfer_only_receipt.scope: Earlier bundle transfer and hash verification; its installed=false predates the separate installation and must not be read as the final installation state.

protocol.voice_checkpoints: Existing GPT-SoVITS v2 fine-tuned GPT/SoVITS checkpoints and reference audio/text
protocol.planned_co_residency_proof: Reference precompute and complete cold utterance before broker-owned Mini load; two actual four-token uncached, untruncated Mini forwards after first and last corpus utterances, with unchanged validated Mini identity.
protocol.measurement_boundary: Operator and dispatch diagnostics are separate from unprofiled formal latency/memory forwards. INT8 weight storage is not evidence of integer GEMM. Whole-machine peak is sampled MemTotal minus minimum MemAvailable, not CUDA allocation alone.
protocol.network_policy: Measured candidate workers deny external network connections and permit only fixed loopback management/inference endpoints.

pressure_telemetry.missing_psi_does_not_block_meminfo_vmsta: Both the local mock and retrieved device JSONL show that unsupported PSI is recorded separately while meminfo/vmstat remain available.

first_campaign.observed_evidence: Full finished campaign JSON, setup stack traces, per-case supervision/restoration logs and pressure telemetry have now been retrieved. All original setup failures remain preserved.

common_setup_failure.stage: Task adapter attempted to load the maintained candidate harness before its model/operator child could run.
common_setup_failure.interpretation: Packaging/setup failure, not a Torch operator, model, voice or co-residency failure.

restoration_last_verified_before_user_re.identity_check: Fixed ProcessRunner argv, UID, stack parent, PID/create time and pidfd before stopping only the owned Mini.

first_campaign.metrics_boundary: Only setup-process and Mini-recovery resource observations exist; the missing harness prevented every candidate operator or voice forward.

repair_and_continuation.packaging_fix_scope: Add candidate harness/installer/parity tooling and CLI build smoke; production server, compact backend and inference implementation unchanged according to root's handoff.
resume_requirements: Root verifies the then-current environment and explicitly hands over the device.
Preserve all prior results and original guards; do not automatically rerun the interrupted campaign.

related_baseline_evidence.scope: Separate root-run formal/allocator and matched original-versus-compact experiments; not candidate results.
related_baseline_evidence.matched_protocol_boundary: Same warmup, thread settings and call order. Historical golden differences also appeared in the original backend; old goldens were not replaced. This does not validate BERT INT8 or Lite voice quality.

claims.conclusion: CPU INT8 micro execution and CUDA BERT INT8 storage were verified. CUDA BERT actually used FP16 GEMM. Compact completed 25 isolated non-silent speech cases. Full candidate latency/memory comparisons, CPU-INT8 BERT, Lite, co-residency, four-token live interleaving and voice-quality evaluation remain unverified and are deferred by the user. No default backend changed.
claims.cpu_micro_evidence: qnnpack executed quantized::linear_dynamic once on a qint8 test Linear; full CPU-INT8 BERT/voice not evaluated.
claims.bert_cuda_storage_evidence: Full 22-layer BERT diagnostic observed 132 INT8 Linear weight stores and 132 FP16,FP16 aten.mm dispatches; no integer GEMM observed.
